claude.sample_unit: model-scenario pairs (320 clinical scenarios x 3 models)

links.outcome: Schema compliance of LLM outputs with vs without validation-repair postprocessing
links.effect: Validation-repair reached 99.0% overall compliance (98.4 to 99.4% across models) vs baseline 85.9 to 91.6%; improvements of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points, McNemar p<0.001.
links.quote: Third, the validation-repair framework achieves 99.0 percent overall compliance, ranging from 98.4 to 99.4 percent across models, with most errors resolving within one or two iterations.

links.outcome: Compliance of AI outputs with schema under automated post-processing validation and repair
links.effect: Automated validation-repair raised compliance to 99.0% from baseline 85.9 to 91.6%; absolute gains of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points, exact McNemar p<0.001.
links.quote: Exact McNemar p-values below 0.001 and absolute improvements of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points across model sizes confirm statistical significance.

unlisted_practices: Closed-loop validator-repair iteration for structured output schema compliance (ICD-10, CPT, HL7 FHIR)
